text: Wanted to see O, but it was on hiatus so we went to La Rêve instead. We were staying at Encore and it was just a walk to the theater. We got seats in the third row. La Rêve is always compared to O, so I thought it was a pretty good substitute. It's not O, but it's a good substitute. I think there's a story but I didn't understand it, but that wasn't a big deal to me. The first part of the show, before the main event, there's a comic lizard-guy swimming in the pool and standing still, like a statue. Then he sneaks up and spits water on the people in the front rows. The main event is the pool, the platforms go up and down. People swim and dive, and they make it look like they're walking on water. Then they dive into the pool from about 25 feet. If you want a really good Vegas show that isn't Cirque du Soleil, which is super expensive, La Rêve is a good substitute. We enjoyed it.
